name: 01-trim-cuts-fades-150
about: Trim 0.25-2.75, cuts 0.8-1.0 and 1.6-1.75 (two 4 ms joins), fade in 0.3, fade out 0.5, volume 150% on a 0.8 sine, so the loudest part clips at full scale. Edited length 2.15 s.
tolerance_about: Largest allowed difference per sample, in 16-bit steps, for renderers that work in floating point (FORMAT.md 7.2). Header and length must match exactly.
